description: Plutus | In Person - Kirkland, WA | Fintech | Full Stack Engineer We are building an investment advisor platform. Raised $5.4M in our recent funding round. The role requires a passion for writing clean code, extreme ownership, and the ability to operate with a deep understanding of the tech stack. Use AI effectively, but own the fundamentals - You leverage AI tools to move faster and be more productive, but you have deep knowledge of the entire stack. You can explain what the code does, debug when things break, and make architectural decisions without relying on AI to tell you what's right. Check out the product at https://www.runplutus.com Job/application information available at https://www.linkedin.com/company/runplutus/jobs/ If you're in the Seattle area, we're hosting a fun builder event (invite only) at our office - https://lnkd.in/p/eir4kRTW
